name: book-orchestra
description: Multi-agent orchestration workflow for authoring, illustrating, reviewing, and typesetting IT & Engineering books natively in Antigravity without external model-provider API keys.

raw_materials_dir.description: Directory containing book_proposal.md (or idea_sparse.md) and technical_notes.md (or experimental_log.md). Ignored when slides_file is supplied.

slides_file.description: Optional lecture deck (.pptx or slide .pdf) to convert into grounded book materials before authoring.

latex_template_dir.description: Directory containing the target LaTeX book template (e.g., templates/oreilly_style_book, templates/manning_in_action_book, templates/systems_handbook).

output_dir.description: Output directory for the generated book manuscript (PDF, LaTeX, Markdown, modular chapters).

proposal_filename.description: Filename of the book proposal inside raw_materials_dir.

technical_notes_filename.description: Filename of the technical notes & benchmarks inside raw_materials_dir.

author_voice.description: Binding authorial voice contract; the proposal remains the primary source of truth.
author_voice.default: Derive and preserve the proposal's own voice; use a warm, exploratory, reader-facing engineering narrative with concrete examples and varied pacing.

use_plotting.description: Whether to generate technical architecture diagrams and benchmark plots in parallel.

visual_density.description: Minimum pedagogical visual coverage per substantive chapter; high targets at least two grounded visuals.

max_reflections.description: Maximum number of 3-Persona Editorial Review Board refinement rounds.

research_cutoff.description: YYYY-MM cutoff date for technical reference synthesis, or null/'current' for runtime current month.

strict_latex.description: Require a real LaTeX compiler (XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX/Tectonic/pdfLaTeX); fail instead of outputting preview_book.pdf.

model.description: Antigravity model tier for authoring agents ('inherit', 'pro', 'flash', 'flash_lite').

writer_model_name.description: Antigravity model tier for blueprint and chapter writing agents (recommended: 'inherit' under Gemini 4 Neon for deep analysis & coding).

reflection_model_name.description: Antigravity model tier for the 3-Persona Editorial Review Board, refinement, and typesetting QA agents.

plotting_model_name.description: Antigravity model tier for the technical diagram & plotting agent (fast/efficient tier recommended for iterative code & critic loops).

image_model_name.description: Antigravity subagent or model for architecture diagrams.

plotting_max_critic_rounds.description: Maximum rounds of visual QA critic self-correction.
